title: Book Three · Chapter 26: Not This Saturday
story:
A few weeks later, the winter holiday is nearly here.

On Monday, Anna puts her exercise books into two small piles. She puts one pile in her bag and holds the other against her coat.

Ronan waits at the classroom door.

“Are you taking the desk too?” he asks.

“Not enough hands.”

He holds the door open. Anna carries the books through and puts them on the wide windowsill outside.

“I need a better bag,” she says.

Ronan thinks of Mum's green and grey one. He moves a loose book inside Anna's open bag while she holds the other things.

Now only one notebook stays in her hand.

They go downstairs together. At the gate, Ronan asks about Saturday.

“Kai wants to walk to the market. Do you want to come?”

Anna shakes her head.

“We are visiting my grandmother.”

“She wants to see my class photo. I promised to bring it.”

“All day?”

“Until the evening.”

Ronan looks toward the street. He wants to ask about Sunday, but Anna is already talking about her holiday work.

“I want to finish the next part of my maths book. Not the whole book. And I want to keep running.”

“Every day?”

“Twice a week. With my friend. There is a path in the park near us.”

She moves the notebook to her other hand.

“By spring, I want three steady laps on our track.”

“You can do two now.”

“Yes. Then the third feels very long.”

They reach the crossing. Ronan stops beside her.

“Maybe another day at the market,” he says.

“Maybe. Tell me how it goes.”

For a moment, he says nothing. He had imagined the three of them outside the shops. Now there will be one empty place in that picture.

Anna looks at the notebook in her hand.

“Thank you for the book.”

“It was yours.”

“For fitting it into the bag.”

He smiles. “No extra charge.”

At the other side, she turns left. Ronan takes the road toward West Lane.

Kai catches up near the next corner. His friend is with him.

“Saturday?” Kai asks.

“Yes. Anna can't come. She has a family visit.”

“All right. We can meet outside the tool shop.”

They agree on ten in the morning. Kai's friend wants to look at a secondhand stall. Kai wants a small tin for his loose screws.

“And you?” Kai asks Ronan.

Ronan thinks for a moment.

“I want to look around. And eat something.”

“An important plan.”

The boys turn into another street. Ronan goes home and puts Saturday's time on his own little sheet.

Then he takes out his school work. The maths page has five questions. He starts the first before dinner.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

windowsill＝窗台；twice a week＝一周两次；steady＝平稳的；secondhand＝二手的。

## 理解问题

1. Anna为什么星期六不能一起去市场？她冬假还想做哪些自己的事？
2. Ronan有没有因此取消和Kai的安排？他们最后约在什么时候、哪里见？

## 读句子

**She moves the notebook to her other hand.**

拆开看：She / moves the notebook / to her other hand.

她／把笔记本换过去／换到另一只手里。
